cfg.title: Settings
cfg.export_title: without API keys and login – to share or use as a template
cfg.export_s_title: complete incl. API keys and password hash – LAN only, keep it safe
cfg.import_title: Load an export file (the login is never overwritten)
cfg.machines_hint: The port range is scanned on every machine. The dashboard detects the engine itself: its own engines (Maya, Basalt, Strata) via /v1/status → service, plus llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, TGI, TabbyAPI, Ollama, LM Studio, KoboldCpp, Triton and any OpenAI-compatible API. If a model moves to another machine, it shows up there automatically. Only private LAN or Tailscale addresses are queried.
cfg.engines_hint: Matched by the service name the server reports. Unknown engines still appear, just grey and with the name from service. The UI path is appended to http://host:port and becomes the “Monitor ↗” link.
cfg.keys_hint: For every server found, the keys are tried in order and the first match is used. Stored keys are masked and kept until you replace them. Key files are JSON files with an api_key field, such as Maya's run config. They are re-read on every scan.
cfg.confirm_secrets:

Treat the file like a password (don't email it, don't commit it).
cfg.bad_json: Import: not a valid JSON file

{m} machines, {e} engines, {keys}.

srv.restart: Port/host take effect after a restart: systemctl --user restart cluster-dashboard
srv.keys_kept: File has no API keys – existing keys kept
srv.miners_tunnel: Miner settings not imported via the tunnel (LAN only)
srv.auth_never: Login (auth) is never imported – existing login kept
srv.miner_kind: miners.{host}: kind must be systemd or ssh
srv.export_lan: Export with secrets only from the LAN, not via the tunnel
login.title: Cluster · Login
login.locked: Too many failed attempts – locked for 10 minutes.
node.no_gpu: no GPU data – start bin/gpu-agent.py on this machine
cfg.other_hint: Besides its own engines the dashboard can detect common inference servers. Only ticked engines are searched for; their ports are added to the port range below. If nothing is ticked, only the own engines are searched. Detected engines get their own card; GPU data comes from the own engine server on the machine or from the GPU agent (bin/gpu-agent.py).
eng.llamacpp: rates and token totals only with --metrics
eng.tabbyapi: /metrics needs network.enable_metrics; add the API key under API keys
eng.ollama: loaded models and VRAM only; needs OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0
eng.lmstudio: loaded model only; enable serving on the local network
eng.triton: requests and GPU data via metrics port 8002
eng.openai: fallback for any OpenAI API with models; no own ports, uses the others
srv.stale: The configuration was changed elsewhere in the meantime. Reload the page and re-enter your changes.
